notes:
v2.0.3 Update
🖼️ Actor Image Source: Actor cut-ins and global styles can use either the saved preset image or the current actor's image. Global style previews and local tests use the selected reference actor.

🏷️ Actor Name Placeholder: The Actor Name button inserts {{name}} into the main text and replaces it with the current actor's name during playback, including direct API and copied macro playback.

🔌 Playable Cut-In API: Integrations can list playable scene cut-ins and actor presets, play them by stable ID, wait for playback to finish, or render them inside a supplied interface element.

🛠️ Global Style Images: Empty global style image paths are no longer replaced by the default hooded image when the editor opens. Current Actor Image takes priority over randomized image variations during playback.

announcement.title: 🎬 Cinematic Cut-ins v2.0.3
announcement.content:
v2.0.3: Actor Images, Name Placeholder, and Playable API

  • Actor cut-ins and global styles can use either their saved preset image or the current actor's image.
  • The Actor Name button inserts {{name}} and replaces it with the current actor's name during playback.
  • New integration APIs list and play presets by stable ID, wait for playback to finish, or keep a cut-in inside a supplied interface element.
  • Blank global style image paths stay blank, and Current Actor Image takes priority over randomized image variations.
